press_references.value: CodeSignal and Harvard Business Impact Bring Hands-On AI and Essential Skills Development to Universities Worldwide

partnership_announcements.description: CodeSignal and Harvard Business Impact announced a partnership to provide practice-based AI literacy and essential-skills courses to educational institutions worldwide.

press_references.value: Leading Universities Join Forces with CodeSignal to Equip Graduates with Industry-Validated Skills

partnership_announcements.description: CodeSignal announced expanded partnerships with universities including Northeastern, Stanford Medicine, UVA, WGU, DeVry University, and Loyola University New Orleans to embed its AI-native skills platform and Career Readiness Academy into coursework for skills verification and experiential learning.

press_references.value: CodeSignal and Harvard Business Review Press Bring HBR Guides to Life through Practice-Based Learning

partnership_announcements.description: CodeSignal announced a partnership with Harvard Business Review Press to adapt HBR Guides into interactive, practice-based learning paths on CodeSignal's platform.

press_references.value: CodeSignal to Launch Free Generative AI Training Program on AWS to Upskill 30,000+ Students Globally

partnership_announcements.description: CodeSignal and Amazon Web Services (AWS) announced an expanded partnership to deliver free generative AI training programs globally, leveraging AWS infrastructure and tools for hands-on learning.

press_references.value: CodeSignal and Go1 Join Forces to Expand AI-Driven, Practice-Based Learning for Modern Workforces

partnership_announcements.description: CodeSignal and Go1 announced a strategic partnership to integrate CodeSignal's AI-driven, practice-based learning into Go1's platform, expanding hands-on training opportunities for technical and business professionals.

press_references.value: AWS Skills to Jobs Tech Alliance and CodeSignal Team Up to Equip 20,000 Students with Job-Ready Tech Skills in Global Pilot

partnership_announcements.description: AWS Skills to Jobs Tech Alliance and CodeSignal have partnered to equip 20,000 students with job-ready tech skills through a global pilot program. The initiative, called 'Skills to Jobs Developer Challenges,' will take place in the Americas and Asia-Pacific regions, involving universities and local employers to bridge the gap between education and employment in the tech sector.

press_references.value: CodeSignal's AI Literacy Assessments Measure Effectiveness of AI Skills Across the Workforce

product_launches.description: CodeSignal expanded and released additional AI literacy assessments for multiple business and technical roles, providing organizations with simulation-based tools to measure how candidates and employees apply AI in real work contexts.

press_references.value: AI-Native Authoring from CodeSignal Helps Teams Create Hands-On Practice at Scale

product_launches.description: CodeSignal launched new AI-native agentic authoring capabilities, powered by its Cosmo AI agent, within CodeSignal Learn to automatically generate role-relevant work simulations and hands-on practice content from prompts or existing training materials.

press_references.value: CodeSignal Launches Industry-First Agentic Coding Assessments for AI-Era Engineering Hiring

product_launches.description: CodeSignal launched new agentic coding assessments that evaluate how engineering candidates use AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to produce real work.

press_references.value: CodeSignal Launches Learn Academies to Embed Skills Validation into the Learning Journey

product_launches.description: CodeSignal introduced Learn Academies, a unified learning and assessment offering that integrates hands-on content with skills validation for workforce development programs.

press_references.value: CodeSignal Launches Multilingual AI Phone Interviews to Scale Skills-Based Screening

product_launches.description: CodeSignal introduced multilingual live phone interview capabilities within its AI Interviewer platform, enabling skills-based screening in over 20 languages via phone as well as web.

press_references.value: CodeSignal Expands Skills-Based Hiring Across Finance, Accounting, and Business Roles

product_launches.description: CodeSignal launched new skills-based hiring and assessment offerings for finance, accounting, and business analysis roles, adding validated assessments, AI interviewer agents, and spreadsheet simulations to extend its platform beyond technical hiring.

press_references.value: CodeSignal to Launch Free Generative AI Training Program on AWS to Upskill 30,000+ Students Globally

product_launches.description: CodeSignal announced the launch of a free generative AI training program on AWS, offering Prompt Engineering and Enterprise AI courses to upskill over 30,000 students globally. The program features hands-on learning with Amazon SageMaker and Amazon Q, aiming to expand access to practical AI skills.

press_references.value: CodeSignal's GenAI Skills Academy Empowers Organizations to Upskill Talent at Every Level

product_launches.description: CodeSignal launched GenAI Skills Academy, a program with three role-based learning tracks to help organizations upskill employees in AI, from basic usage to advanced AI research and integration.

press_references.value: CodeSignal and TED Transform Learning with AI-Native Practice That Brings TED Talks to Life

product_launches.description: CodeSignal launched its Experts Series, a new set of AI-native, hands-on learning courses inspired by TED Talks, enabling learners to practice and apply insights from influential thought leaders.

press_references.value: CodeSignal Launches AI-Powered Interviewer Training to Revolutionize How Teams Conduct Interviews Across Technical and Business Roles

product_launches.description: An AI-powered training tool that uses immersive simulations to teach interviewers how to conduct fair, skills-focused interviews.

overview_description.description:
CodeSignal is how the world discovers and develops the skills that will shape the future. Our skills platform empowers teams to go beyond skills gaps, with hiring and AI-powered learning solutions, and helps individuals cultivate the skills they need to level up. Wherever you are on your journey, CodeSignal’s technical hiring and learning & development solutions meet you there and get you where you need to go.
Having powered millions of skills evaluations, CodeSignal is trusted by leading companies like Netflix, Capital One, Meta, and Dropbox, and is used by learners across the globe.

about_short_description.short_description: CodeSignal is a skill assessment platform that provides live tech interviews, skills development, and learning tools.

product.name: AI Interviewer
product.description: An AI-powered interviewing service that conducts structured, role-specific interviews and produces standardized skills reports for human review.

product.name: Skills Assessments
product.description: A skills assessment suite for measuring technical, business, AI-related, and behavioral capabilities through validated, job-relevant tests and simulations.

product.name: Live Tech Interviews
product.description: A collaborative technical interviewing environment where candidates code and communicate in a shared integrated development environment while interviewers evaluate their performance.

product.name: CodeSignal Learn
product.description: A practice-based learning platform that helps individuals and organizations build technical and business skills through courses, assessments, hands-on practice, and feedback.

product.name: Skills Intelligence
product.description: A workforce analytics and benchmarking service that maps organizational skills, identifies gaps, and supports data-driven hiring, development, and talent planning.

product.name: Technical Hiring Solutions
product.description: A set of technical recruiting services for screening, assessing, interviewing, and selecting candidates based on job-relevant engineering and technology skills.
